5706.name: Tattered map
5706.description: A torn treasure map. Use it to read where it leads; use it again inside that ground to know if you are close.

9172.name: Vault Key
9172.description: A heavy iron key stamped with a coin.

5799.name: Goldback's Crown
5799.description: A tiny golden crown that sat on the Goldback Toad's head. A keepsake for a house shelf.

3044.name: Frenzied Tusk
3044.description: A tusk with a red scorch at the root, from the Frenzied Boar. A keepsake for a house wall.

12544.name: Pale Antlers
12544.description: White antlers from the Pale Stag, mounted for a house wall.

35571.name: Paymaster's Strongbox
35571.description: The bandits' payroll chest, empty now, with the Paymaster's tally still scratched inside the lid.

10289.name: Smuggler's Lantern
10289.description: A shuttered lantern the smugglers signalled with. A keepsake for a house.

10415.name: Bandit Banner
10415.description: The road gang's tattered banner, dug out of a buried stash. A keepsake for a house wall.

8146.name: Ruin Idol
8146.description: A small stone idol from before the tower. Nobody knows who it was meant to be.

8773.name: Captain's Sea Chest
8773.description: A bandit captain's chest, salt-stained from some far coast. A keepsake for a house.

10302.name: Old Climber's Compass
10302.description: A compass that points up, not north. It belonged to a climber long before you.

28538.name: Wardwright Tablet
28538.description: A clay tablet marked by the Wardwrights, the tower's builders. A keepsake for a house.

2819.name: hammer-mark rubbing
2819.description: A charcoal rubbing of a mason's mark: a hammer.

2833.name: star-mark rubbing
2833.description: A charcoal rubbing of a mason's mark: a six-pointed star.

4831.name: wheel-mark rubbing
4831.description: A charcoal rubbing of a mason's mark: a wheel.
